tei:div.tei:p: / skong gso dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so/ / dpal gyi srung ma'i skong gso dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mthu rtsal yon tan rmad du byung*/ /drag po khros pa bka' srung dam can la/ /dpal 'byor 'dod slad dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ /dpal gyi skong gso dngos grub char 'bebs bri/ /gsang phye gtsang ma la dpal gtor mtheb skyu sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba'i g.yas su gza'i bshos bu dgus bskor/ g.yon du dam can gyi bshos bu mkhar thabs btsan bshos ra skyes kyis brgyan pa bshams la/ dkar dang dmar gyis thig bkye/ dar zab gdugs ldem gyi 'phur lces brgyan pa'i spyan gzigs rgya cher bshams/ mchod pa lngas mtha' bskor/ rnga dang dung dang cha lang dang mi rkang gi gling bu dang*/ tshil chen gyi dud pa la sogs pas phun sum tshogs par byas la/ rol mos byin dbab cing*/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis 'dod pa'i yon tan sha khrag gi zhal zas ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam par byin gyis brlabs la/ sngon 'gro bgegs gtor byin nas rol mo dang sum+bha nis dgegs bskrad de 'khod nas mgrin gcig tu/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la skyabs su song nas/ dang po la mtshams gcad pa/ hūṃ rang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i/ /srid gsum bde 'gro khams gsum yum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhing dbyug 'dzin/ /ral gcig spyan gcig mche ba gca ི ga /thal chen zhag gi zo ris mtshan/ /thod phreng zhing lpags rnam par dkris/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum stong khams khyab/ /smug nag gsang ba'i bha ga las/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra 'phros pas/ /sprul pa'i khro chung glog ltar 'khyug /khro bo'i gsung sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /bskal pa'i me ri 'du 'phro 'bar/ /yang sprul grangs med sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /ye shes pho nya glog ltar 'khyug /phyag mtshan gsung sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /bskal ba'i me ri 'du 'phro 'bar/

/dur khrod ma mo char ltar 'bab/ /rlung yang 'gyu ba'i skabs med na/ /bar chad bgegs rnams smos ci dgos/ /ā+oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ /gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūṃ a na ya ho/ bha ga wā na/ bid+ya rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa bskyed pa las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum nas rim par gsal gdab pa ni/ hūṃ stong pa rang bzhin ma bcos nyid/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag 'dus ma byas/ /phyi dang nang med chos kyi dbyings/ /bsam brjod bral ba'i klong nyid do/ /ā+oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dza na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ ma ni skye ba med pa las/ ma ni 'gags pa med par 'byung*/ /tri dang tri yi 'phro 'du las/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /ā+oṃ ma hā dz+nyā badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ snang srid gsal ba'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /e dang yaṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ khaṃ dang saṃ dang raṃ yi ge / thams cad 'jig cing chags stongs so/ /e yaṃ khaṃ saṃ raṃ s+phar ṇa phaṭa/ e nang yaṃ gi gnas gsal bas/ /rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i rgya gram steng*/ khaṃ dang raṃ gyi gnas gsal bas/ /rak+ta'i chu bo me rlung 'bar/ /keṃ dang bh+ruṃ gyi gnas gsal bas/ /keng rus sa gzhi gzhal med khang*/ /phyogs bcur rgya yongs ma chad pa/ /thod mkhar rin chen 'bar bas brgyan/ /sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta bab bzhi/ /'khor lo gdugs dang mi mgo'i tog /zhing chen bla bres rgyal mtshan 'phan/ /rgyu ma'i drwa phyed don snying 'phyar/ /khrag dang zhag gi zham chu 'bab/ / tshil chen bdug spos sprin phung 'khrigs/ /glog dang 'od kyi tshogs 'gyu zhing*/ /thog dang mtshon cha skar mda' 'khrugs/ /mkha' 'gro 'jigs pa'i sprin 'phro zhing*/ /hūṃ dang phaṭaḥkyi 'brug stong sgrogs/ /rak+ta'i bzed phor mchod sprin 'gyed/ /'bar ba'i klong gi gzhal yas khang*/ /rab 'jigs yangs pa chen po'i dbus/ /nyi zla pad+ma bam chen steng*/

/ma dang ma yi 'phro 'du las/ /smug nag ral gcig gnam sa khyab/ /thod phreng mi mgo 'bar bas brjid/ /zhal gcig spyan gcig mche ba gcig /brang gi lhan snar rab tu slebs/ /phyag g.yas zhing dbyug g.yon na mo/ /snying zhags khrag 'bab zhal du gsol/ /gcer bur zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /ba spu me 'od mtshon cha 'phro/ /zhing lpags stod dkris rus pas brgyan/ /hūṃ dpa' mo mi bsnyengs 'jigs pa'i g.yas/ /gza' bdud ljang nag dbu dgu pa/ / zhal re spyan gsum bya rog mgo /mda' gzhu chu srin rgyal mtshan gzhu/ / g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams/ /sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba ste/ / mgo lus med par mig gis khengs/ /sku las bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar/ /hūṃ khrag 'thung 'bar ma chen mo'i g.yon/ /skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsal/ /dmar nag zhal gcig spyan gsum brjid/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje snying zhags g.yon/ /seng ge dkar mo chibs pa ste/ /thod phreng mi lpags g.yang gzhi dang*/ /'ja' tshon 'bar bas sku la 'khyil/ /bskal ba'i me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /hūṃ 'bar ba klong gi bar khyams dang*/ /phyogs mtshams khyab par mkha' 'gro ging*/ /dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor tshogs dang*/ /steng na sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /bya tshogs mang po skar ltar 'khrugs/ /mtha' bskor stag gzig dom dred khyi/ /mi nag 'o dod 'bod pas 'khrigs/ /mi rkang gling bu de ri ri/ /rngams pa'i bshugs glu kyu ru ru/ /rgod pa'i gad rgyangs ya la la/ / 'jigs pa'i bro chen chems se chem/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal/ /ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ de nas bzhengs su gsol zhing spyan drangs te mchod bstod byas la bstim pa ni/ tshig phyir sems gzhol bas/ hūṃ ngang nyid chos sku 'gyur med dag pa'i klong*/ /'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings mchog rab 'byams nas/ /dpal chen sku la gnyis med 'khril sbyor ba/ / e ka dza ṭī gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/

/dpal gyi 'khor tshogs ye shes rol pa las/ /chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar sku bzhengs la/ /ye shes mthongs phye ma rig mun pa sol/ /mnyam nyid rdzogs pa'i don rnams so sor phye/ /ā badz+ra dh+ri ka dza ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ /hūṃ bskal pa rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /las kyi ye shes tshogs kyi rje mo ni/ /dpal ldan gtso mo e ka dza ṭī ma/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed 'khor dang bcas/ /ru lu'i sgra skad nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /lho sprin 'thibs tshul sku mdog sna tshogs ston/ /glog ltar 'khyug cing gang la'ang thogs pa med/ /dus bzhir nyul zhing bstan pa'i dam rdzas srung*/ /rnal 'byor skyong zhing re ba bskang ngo zhes/ /zhal bzhes gang lags rjes su mthun dgongs la/ /dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bdag la byin rlobs dkyil 'khor gnyan po zung*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod yon 'di bzhes la/ 'dod pa'i don dgongs phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin chen gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ ma ma tri tri ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de nas dam bca' ba'i mchod pa dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod bshags dang*/ bstod gsol gyi mchod pa rnams bya ba las/ dam bca'i mchod pa la gdung sems bskyed la thal mo sbyar la/ hūṃ deng nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /g.yar dam gcig pas thugs rjes dgongs su gsol/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan mos pas gsal bar bya/ /lus ngag yid kyi gdung ba dam pa yis/ /lha mchog nyid dang ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /bdag dang mi 'bral sems kyis goms par bgyi/ /bdag ni khyod mthong dngos su bltar med pas/ /mun pa'i tshogs dang 'dra bar mchis mod kyis/ /gdung sems dam pas yid ches dngos ji bzhin/ /re zhing ltos so byams ldan thugs rje'i yum/ khyod ni ye shes sgrib med zhal mnga' bas/

/ dus 'dir byin rlobs thugs rje'i zhal bzang ston/ /rdo rje mchog gsum sgrub pa'i dam tshig mchog /deng nas brtsams te bdag gis gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes pa gsum brjod do/ /phyi nang gi mchod bshags la/ spy-ir bya ba dang*/ khyad par du bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag gi snying kha nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros mchod gtor la phog / raṃ gyis bsregs/ khaṃ gis sbyangs/ yaṃ gis gtor/ ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang las ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ 'phros/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa so so sa dang bar snang gang bar bsams la/ dbul ba ni/ hūṃ dpal ldan gtso mo 'khor bcas spyan snga ru/ / spos dang me tog snang gsal dri mchog dang*/ /zhal zas rol mo 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs/ /gtsang sbyar mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ dhū pe dhū/ ā lo ke a/ gan+dhe gan/ nai wi te ā: shab+ta hūṃ/ tsha traṃ traṃ/ dh+wa dza sa mā ye pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrin las tshad med brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings 'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs sku cir yang ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs rmad du byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes gdugs bzhin skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /che ba'i yon tan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bstan srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ dpal gyi yum chen dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor bcas gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni sgrub mchog nges pa'i rnal 'byor gcig /gsang chen bla na med pa'i lam zhugs te/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig mnos pa las/

/'gal 'khrul nyams chag nongs pa mthol lo bshags/ /srung ma khyed brten bsgrub pa'i khas blangs kyang*/ /rkyen dbang le los de ltar rngo ma thogs/ /tshogs mchog chung zhing skong ba ma rdzogs sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mtho lo bshags/ /dur khrod gsar ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /thal chen g.yang gzhi zhing chen gsar rnying sogs/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog ma tshang ma 'byor bas/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /dza gad phud dang pañtsa a mṛ ta/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma la sogs te/ / mchod cing bskang ba'i dam rdzas ma tshang ba/ /thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /sgrub pa yun thung bzlas grangs nyung ba dang*/ /thun zor ma lcogs le lo'i dbang gyur pas/ /lha mchog khyed dang da dung zhal ma mjal/ /thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /bdag ni dang po'i las can gti mug pas/ /sems nyid don gyi bden pa ma mthong ste/ /the tshom som nyi nyon mongs log lta sogs/ /chos nyid don gyis 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /ma rig bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /'khor rkyen ngan pa'i las kyis mtshams sbyar te/ /mu mtha' med pas srid par 'jug la sogs/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /gsang sngags sgrub rdzas tshogs par dka' ba dang*/ /dus ngan skye bo log rtog che ba dang*/ /bdag ni nyam chung blo gros rab dman pas/ / gsang chen thabs dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin chu bo'i gzhung chen bzhin/ /bsgrub cing dpyad pas dang du blang rgyu las/ /don med 'khrul pa'i las la g.yengs gyur pa/ /'gal 'khrul nyes pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /ngo mtshar chen po bde bar gshegs rnams kyi/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa rmad byung rol pa rnams/ /dang du ma blangs smad cing log par bltas/ /sbyor sgrol las mtha' log pa mthol lo bshags/ /dben par bsgrubs cing dang du blang rgyu la/

/gsang sgo 'chol zhing mang po'i tshogs su bsgrags/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /nyams grib nyes ltung thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /bdag gis 'gal 'khrul nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /ye shes spyan mnga' khyed kyi thugs la 'gal/ /de kun ma lus dus 'dir mthol lo bshags/ khyed kyi thugs rje dag par mdzad du gsol/ /sngon tshe dpal chen 'bar ba'i spyan snga ru/ / nyams chag bskang zhing bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes/ /zhal bzhes gang lags dus 'dir bsgrubs lags kyi/ /bdag gi 'gal 'khrul nyams chag sbyang du gsol/ /bems po'i rang bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yang*/ /lha mi'i re 'dod yid bzhin skong mdzad na/ /khyed ni bsam 'phel yid bzhin cis mi mdzad/ /bdag gi mngon 'dod re ba bskang du gsol/ /don dam ma skyes mkha' ltar dag pa la/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang*/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi rang bzhin du/ / 'gal 'khrul nyes pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ khyed ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin cir yang bsgyur/ /bdag gis 'gal 'khrul nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /bshags pas tshangs te dag pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /thugs rjes bskyang zhing re ba bskang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya zhes pa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ /gnyis pa khyad par bya ba la/ byin gyis brlab pa dang 'bul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi'i bsangs chu gtor la tshig gi phyir sems gzhol bas/ /hūṃ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /tshogs gtor sbyang phyir yi ge spro/ /raṃ las me 'bar thams cad bsreg /yaṃ las rlung byung ma lus gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung dag par sbyangs/ /ā+oṃ las 'dod yon rnam lngar gyur/ /āḥlas mkha' dbyings ma lus khyab/ /hūṃ las 'dod dgu'i dngos por gyur/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cog/bla med mchod pa'i sprin du 'khrigs/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā pū dza me ga su ra to ho ti pu pheṃ hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/

'bul ba la drug las/ dang po sman 'bul ba ni dri'i dung chos nas 'thor zhing*/ hūṃ sna tshogs 'dus pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong*/ /e ka dza ṭī 'khor bcas la/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsis mchod/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ /rak+ta ni dngos sam bshams pa la dmigs te/ hūṃ chags pa dngos dag rang byung ka pā lar/ /'dod chags rnam dag dmar gsal rak+ta'i rgyun/ /bde chen dbyings su dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /dgyes par bzhes la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ bdud rtsi ni mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ ā+oṃ 'bru bcud dngas ma dngos grub dam pa'i rdzas/ /dza gad dpa' bo kun nas byin che ba/ /ting 'dzin dngos bshams dag pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs rjes bzhes la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la/ ā+oṃ gzhong pa rnam dag chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyar/ /gtor ma rnam dag ri dang rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /dkar dmar thig bkye sha khrag bdud rtsis bran/ /e ka dza ṭī 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam rdzas dngos 'byor dag pa'i gtor chen 'di/ /ting 'dzin dgongs klong dag pas byin brlabs te/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun gang bar phul ba yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta/ te dzo ba liṃ ta/ ma hā ko nri thā/ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ tshogs mchod ni/ gsum du bcad pa snod so sor phul la/ hūṃ dpal chen gsang ba dbyings kyi yum/ /'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /'dir gshegs rnal 'byor tshogs la rol/ /hūṃ khrag 'thung 'bar ba ral gcig chen mo dang*/ /sprul pa'i gza' mchog yang sprul pho nya brgyad/ /skyes mchog 'bar ba mched dang sku 'khor bcas/ /dbyings kyi yum drug nyi zla thod phreng dang*/

/dkar mo spyan gcig sman mo lnga bcu gnyis/ / dregs pa sde brgyad mkha' 'gro pho nya ging*/ /dam can srung ma brtan cing bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /bod khams skyong ba'i lha chen bstan mar bcas/ /yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnam dag 'dod yon lnga yi tshogs la rol/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ /hūṃ lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i las rnams la/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rkyen bslangs nas/ /las kyi dbang gis khams gsum 'khor 'bras ni/ /ma rig ma shes ma mthong gsum gyis ni/ /las kyi mtshams rtsal 'khor pa'i las 'bras bsags/ /nyams dang 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nyes ltung kun/ / gnong 'gyod gdung ba'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /dag nas tshangs te bzod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la sogs pa'i/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bgyis pa rnams/ /tshogs kyi mchod chen 'dis bskang mthol lo bshags/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod nas/ dug gsum sha khrag gi mchod pa ni/ nya bo bsgral la gtor mar phul te/ hūṃ bstan pa yongs la gnod pa dang*/ /sems can kun la 'tshe ba dang*/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra /dam nyams 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /sha rus ri rab brtsegs pa la/ /rak+ta'i zham chu rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dbang po rnam shes drod dang dbugs/ /phung po skye mched khams dang bcas/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab/ bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā rū dra che ge 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pa dang rak+tas bran no/ /skong mchod ni gtor mar sman raka bran/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bran la gsur gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgras mchod cing*/ hūṃ dpal gyi dam can rgya mtsho la/

/phyi mchod rin chen sna lngas bskang*/ /spos dang mar mes thugs dam bskang*/ /zhal zas rol mos thugs dam bskang*/ /sil snyan glu gar dbyangs kyis bskang*/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dar zab bskang*/ /sman dang me tog rin chen bskang*/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon rnam lngas bskang*/ /bskangs pas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ hūṃ dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ nang mchod bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang*/ /sman dang rak+tas thugs dam bskang*/ /dza gad dmar chen gtor mas bskang*/ /zhun chen snang gsal mar mes bskang*/ /gsur chen dri yi dud pas bskang*/ /zhing chen bla bres rgyan gyis bskang*/ /thod phreng zhing dbyugs bhan+dhas bskang*/ /mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan zhags pas bskang*/ rdo rje dgra snying 'bar bas bskang*/ /phyag mtshan zhing lpags chas kyis bskang*/ /seng ge glang chen rta mchog bskang*/ /khyu mchog gzig dang ma hes bskang*/ /ce spyang dom dred bdud byas bskang*/ /mi nag bya nag khyi nag bskang*/ /dpal gyi pho nya'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bskangs bas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /hūm̐ dpal 'bar chen mo 'khor bcas la/ /gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mchod pas bskang*/ /thabs dang shes rab dgyes sprin bskang*/ / mkha' mnyam byang chub sems kyis bskang*/ /snang srid sangs rgyas zhing du bskang*/ /snod bcu lha dang lha mor bskang*/ /gzugs snang sku yi dkyil 'khor bskang*/ /sgrar snang gsung gi dkyil 'khor bskang*/ /dran rig thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bskang*/ /nyon mongs ye shes chen por bskang*/ /dgag sgrub byang chub sems su bskang*/ /chos rnams ma skyes stong par bskang*/ /stong rig chos dbyings gdal bar bskang*/ /bskangs pas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bstod gsol gyi mchod pa la gnyis las/ dang po bstod pa ni/ hūṃ bdag nyid chen mo e ka dza ṭī ma/ /chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu mar skur sprul te/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring skyong mdzad ma/

/las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mor bstod/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med rtags su/ /sku mdog smug nag ral gcig spyan gcig tshems/ /thig le nyag cig ngang las ma g.yos ma/ /bsam brjod spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par 'phrul ba'i rtags/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum phyag gnyis zhing dbyug dang*/ /snying zhags 'dzin pas gar yang thogs pa med/ / 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpa' mo mi bsnyengs bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /gcer bu brjid rngam stong khams 'bar ba'i sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan thod phreng g.yang gzhis mtshan/ /gtso mo bde gshegs lhun gyis grub la bstod/ /hūṃ ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas kyang*/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ /drang srong chen po gza' mchog rā hu la/ /mthu chen drag po 'dod dgur bsgyur la bstod/ /theg pa rim dgu sa dgu 'das pa'i rtags/ /dbu dgu steng zhal bya rog brtsegs pa'i gdong*/ / dus gsum gzigs shing bstan pa bsrung ba'i rtags/ /spyan stong bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar la bstod/ /don gnyis lhun grub mtha' bzh-i dag pa'i rtags/ /g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu zhags pa rgyal mtshan phyar/ /'khor ba dag kyang thugs rjes sgrol ba'i rtags/ /sku smad sbrul stong chun pos mdzes la bstod/ /hūṃ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'bar ba'i cha lugs cir yang ston/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /badz+ra thig le rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rig 'dzin sa bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'ja' tshon 'bar ba la/ / dgongs pa chos nyid dbyings su dag pa'i rtags/ /thor tshugs rtse nas dud sprin 'phyur la bstod/ /rim dgu dam chos snying po 'dzin pa'i rtags/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gnam la gsor/ /snying tig bsrung zhing nyams pa sgrol ba'i rtags/

/phyag g.yon snying zhags thugs kar 'dzin la bstod/ /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dbang phyug brnyes pa'i rtags/ /mi bzad seng ge dkar mo'i steng na chibs/ /'dod dgur bsgyur zhing bstan pa bsrung ba'i rtags/ / dpal gyi chas brgyad sku mchog mdzes la bstod/ /hūṃ 'bar ba'i 'khor na bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ / rnal 'byor skyong zhing bdud 'dul drag po'i sku/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe rang byung pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bcas rin chen gter gyi bdag

/bod khams skyong ba'i lha rab bstan mar bcas/ /yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mnga' gsol ba ni/ phud dang gtsang mar spags/ mtshams su rol mo dkrol zhing*/ gsur gyi dud pa 'thul/ me tog gi char dbab cing 'di skad do/ /ho chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/ /yangs pa chen po'i gnas mchog /lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas/ dpal kun tu bzang po la 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ dpal mgon rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ ngang nyid chos kyi sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ / thugs rje ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs te/ bdag gi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir dad pas spyan 'dren gyis/ thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te skad cig nyid la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ byon nas kyang nyi zla pad+ma rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs te/ rnal 'byor gyi mchod yod dam pa bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza: auṃ badz+ra sa mā ya staṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā yi tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ ho: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa/ dgyes shing bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/ rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ /dza gad phud kyi dngas ma/ zhal zas gtor ma'i rol pa/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' klas par rgyas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo/ / gsol lo/ /mchod do/

/dgyes pa'i zhal ston zhig /sgrubs pa'i rtags phyung zhig /'dod dgu'i re ba skongs shig /lta dgongs dang ting nge 'dzin spel zhing*/ 'gal 'khrul dang nyams chag skongs shig /'khor dang 'byor pa spel zhig /bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /rkyen dang bar chad zlog cig / bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig /ho dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma chen mo/ kun tu bzang mo'i sprul pa chen mo/ mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i gtso mo chen mo/ las dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rje mo chen mo/ thugs zhi ba chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang sku 'bar ba'i cha lugs shin tu rngams pas brjid pa/ sku mdog smug nag 'od stong 'bar ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs su rung ba/ / spyan gcig skye dgu kun la gzigs pa/ /tshems gcig dam nyams zhal du gsol ba/ /phyag g.yas zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ /g.yon na snying dang rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rab tu brjid pa/ /thod phreng mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang ba/ /thal chen zhal gis thig les mtshan pa/ /zhing lpags rlon pa stod la dkris pa/ / gcer bu ha ha hūṃ sgra rgod pa/ /hi hi dgyes pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa/ /bshugs pa'i 'thor rlung shin tu 'jigs pa/ /ru lu'i sgra skad 'brug stong ldir ba/ /sku gcig stong khams kun tu khyab pa/ /gsung gcig nam mkha'i mtha' la 'jal ba/ /thugs gcig shes bya'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs pa/ khams gsum sems can phyag na bsnams pa/ /snang srid 'khor 'das bha gar tshud pa/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi rje mo chen mo/ /kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong yangs pa/ /dus bzhi dbyings kyi bdag ma ོ chen mo la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ston c-ig /bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyung zhig gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /grub pa'i rtags phyung zhig /bcol pa'i las mdzod cig

/rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi la nad rims ma btang*/ nor la stor brlag ma btang*/ bsam pa la bar chad ma btang*/ bka' chad dang ye 'drog ma btang*/ phyugs la god kha ma btang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa ma btang*/ blon po dbang sgyur ma btang*/ dmangs kyi yo lang ma btang*/ ban bon gyi zor kha ma btang*/ sngags 'chang gi phur kha ma btang*/ bdud kyi khrom kha ma btang*/ btsan gyi shod kha ma btang*/ gza'i dal kha ma btang*/ sde brgyad kyi gnod pa ma btang*/ rkyen dang bar chad ma btang*/ gzhan yang mtha' bzhir rgyal ba'i ru dar phyor cig /dpal 'byor mnga' thang sde dpung skyed cig /thams cad 'dun pa'i mthu dpal skyed cig /snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgrogs shig /yul khams bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug sdus shig /tshe dpal 'byor pa'i dngos grub stsol zhig /bsam pa bsgrub la re ba skongs shig /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /ho 'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog chen po/ / sdon tshe dka' ba sna tshogs spyad pas/ /da lta mthu dang rdzu 'phrul brnyes pa/ / bla na med pa'i bstan pa srung zhing*/ /dam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor skyong ba/ mkhan po chen po/ las mkhan chen po/ sgrol ging chen po/ skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsal/ sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ /ral pa'i rtse nas du ba 'phyur ba/ /spyan gsum bskal ba'i me 'od 'phro ba/ /zhal gdangs rno dkar mche ba gtsigs pa/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gsor pa/ /g.yon pas snying dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ /thod phreng mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ /stag sham sku yi rnam byed dkris pa/ /thal chen zhag gi thig le byas pa/ /seng ge dkar mo chibs su bcibs pa/ /bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad chas pa/ /nad dang tshon gyi gru gu rkyong pa/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshen rje rngams pa la gsol lo/ 'bul lo mchod do/ /legs pa chos shig /nyes pa zlog cig /bsam pa dang re ba thams cad skongs shig

/rnal 'byor pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi la na tsha ma btang*/ phyugs la god kha ma btang*/ kha smras dang gleng brjod ma btang*/ mi kha dang dal yams ma btang*/ dgra rkun dang 'tshe ba ma btang*/ gzhan yang gzhi la sdod na legs par srungs shig /byes su 'gro na mgon skya ོ bas mdzod cig /lam 'phrang 'jigs sar skyel bsu gyis shig /chu la 'gro na sgrol 'don mdzod cig /tshong la 'gro na tshong dpon gyis shig /dmag la 'gro na dmag dpon gyis shig /jag la 'gro na jag dpon gyis shig /dgra dang rtsod na pha rol non zhig /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam du chug cig /mnyam gnyis gong du legs par thon zhig /snyan pa bsgrub la grags pa sgrogs shig /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /ho bka' sdod las kyi sprul pa chen po/ /pho nya yang sprul dam can rgya mtsho/ /dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan cir yang bsgyur ba/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa/ /la la thog dang ser chen 'bebs pa/ /la la nad dang skar mda' gtong ba/ /la la mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ /la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud pa/ /la la ru mtshon ba dan 'phyar ba/ /la la stag gzig dom dred zhon pa/ /la la mi nag 'o dod 'bod pa/ /la la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gdengs pa/ /la la bdud bya sprin ltar lding ba/ /la la khyi spyang 'ur ba rgyug pa/ /'bum phrag bye ba dpag tu med pa/ /pho nya yang sprul las mkhan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /grub pa'i rtags phyung zhig /bka' yi bya ra gyis shig / bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nyin gsum gyi bya ra gyis shig /mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe gyis shig /rgyab kyi brten ma gyis shig /mdun gyi 'khar ba gyis shig /g.yas kyi dpung gnyen gyis shig /g.yon gyi mgon skyabs gyis

shig /sdang ba'i dgra sod cig /gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig /rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol cig /'dod don dang phrin las sgrubs shig /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig / ho/ gangs ri rgyud kyi bdag po chen po/ /chos rgyal rje yi mgur lha chen po/ /rin chen gter gyi bdag po chen po/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i dge bsnyen chen po/ /gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje sham po/ rdo rje thang lha/ rdo rje gang bzang*/ rdo rje ra skyes/ rdo rje mkha' ri la sogs pa lha gnyen chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig / grub pa'i rtags phyung zhig /bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig /tshe dang dpal 'byor spel zhig /yul khams dang sa phyogs skyongs shig /snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs shig /mi kha dang dal yams sgyur cig /bsam dgu dang re ba skongs shig /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /dkyil 'khor gnyen gyi srung ma chen mo/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i gtso mo chen mo/ bod yul skyong ba'i bstan ma chen mo/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bran g.yog chen mo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po'i bka'i 'khor na gnas pa/ nag mo mi sdug pa'i bu mo rdo rje kun grags ma la sogs pa bdud mo chen po bzhi dang*/ dmar mo khrag 'dzags ma'i bu mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la sogs pa gnod sbyin mo chen mo bzhi dang*/ dkar sham bzhin bzangs ma'i bu mo rdo rje bod khams skyong ba la sogs pa sman mo chen mo bzhi dang*/ yul lha bzhi bdag gi tshogs 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /grub pa'i rtags phyung zhig /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad dang gnod pa skyobs shig /tshe dang dpal 'byor spel zhig

/mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzod cig / bsam dgu'i re ba skongs shig /rkyen ngan dang bar chad sol cig /bdag las 'phags pa'i grags pa sgrogs shig /gzhan las rgyal ba'i ru dar phyor zhig /mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i gong du thon zhig /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag med skyed cig /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /ho bdag cag rdo rje dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa/ dgung sngon mthon po bas dpangs mtho bar mdzod cig /nyi zla gza' skar bas 'od gsal bar gyis shig /ri bdun rol mtsho bas brjid che bar gyis shig / gling bzhi gling phran pas gnas mang bar gyis shig /lha dbang brgya byin bas bka' btsan par gyis shig /'khor los sgyur rgyal bas mnga' thang che bar gyis shig /rgya mtsho chen po bas klor yangs par gyis shig /yid bzhin nor bu bas dgos 'dod 'byung bar gyis shig /klu dbang chen po bas brjid che bar gyis shig /gangs ri brtsegs pa bas ring du 'tsher bar gyis shig / dpag bsam shing chen bas 'khor 'dab rgyas par gyis shig /bum pa bzang po bas bkra shis bar gyis shig bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par gyis shig / ces brjod do/ /de nas gtor ma cung zad bsgyur la bdud rtsi bran te/ bh+yo: srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na/ chos dbyings brnyes kyang 'jig rten cha lugs 'dzin/ /ye shes grub kyang las kyi pho nyar ston/ /so so'i rigs dang ming srid lcam dral tshul/ /bdag cag rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la/ /chag che nyam nga thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ / bh+yo: dkar mo spyan gcig rdo rje rigs kyi lcam/ / nyid kyi ming po srog bdag kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /shar phyogs glo bur ye 'grog shor ra re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro shar phyogs glo bur ye 'grog sgyur/ /bh+yo: sngon po shugs 'chang rin chen rigs kyi lcam/

/nyid kyi ming po gshen rje'i kha sgyur cig / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i khram la btab pa re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro gshin rje'i khram la btab pa sgyur/ /bh+yo: dmar mo shugs 'chang pad+ma rigs kyi lcam/ /nyid kyi ming po klu rgyal kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /nub phyogs klu yis byad du bcug ga re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro klu yis byang du bcug pa sgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ nag mo shugs 'chang las kyi rigs kyi lcam/ /nyid kyi ming po gnod sbyin kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ / byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon gyis zin ta re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro gnod sbyin gdon gyis zin pa sgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ srid pa bde 'gro ma ni phya yi lcam/ /nyid kyi ming po phya yi kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mgon tshul phya yi gra snying phye ya re/ / bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro phya yi gra snying 'byed pa sgyur/ / bh+ya ོཿ srid pa bde 'gro ma ni bdud kyi lcam/ /nyid kyi ming po kos rje kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bdud sde nag po'i khram la btab pa re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro bdud kyis khram la btab pa sgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ e ka dza ṭī nag mo thal mdog ma/ /nyid kyi ming po bdud sde'i kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bdud kyis tshe dang srog la brkus pa re/ / bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro bdud kyis tshe la brku ba sgyur/ /bh+ya ོཿ dkar mo chen mo nyi zla thod phreng can/ /nyid kyi ming po gnam the'u kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/

/rdo rje rgyal po dmangs su phab pa re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog / bsgyur ro gnam the'u dkar po'i cho 'phrul sgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ dkar mo chen mo mi bzad nyi ma'i mdangs/ /nyid kyi ming po gza' bdud kha sgyur cig / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gza' bdud nag po'i dal kha bab pa de/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro gza' yi dal kha bab pa bsgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ btsan la rag mo rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /nyid kyi ming po btsan bdud kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /btsan bdud sde bzhi'i shod la 'god pa re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro btsan bdud shod la 'god pa bsgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ sa bdag chen mo 'jigs byed pad ma'i phreng*/ /nyid kyi ming po sa srin kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sa srin lte po'i gdon gyis zin ta re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro sa bdag gdon gyis zin pa sgyur/ /bh+yo ཿ 'jigs byed chen mo khrag g-i ral pa can/ /nyid kyi ming po 'byung po'i kha sgyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'byung po'i cho 'phrul yul du phebs pa re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog

/bsgyur ro 'byung po nag po'i cho 'phrul sgyur/ /mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mi nad phyugs nad god kha shor nga re/ /dam nyams dgra yi gnod pa byung ra re/ /glo bur ye 'drog rkyen ngan byung nga re/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig byung nga re/ /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu byung nga re/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen ngan byung nga re/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog /bsgyur ro mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams sgyur/ /bzlog cig bsgyur cig ming sring 'khor bcas rnams/ /bar chad sol la 'dod don grub par mdzod/ ā+oṃ ma ma tri tri rak+ṣa sa mā ya bh+yo bh+yo ཿ zhes brjod do/ /de nas mngon spyod kyi las 'ga' zhig sgrub pa'i dus yin na/ ma sring las la bskul/ / dus min na bstan ma skyong ba la sogs pa bya la/ /las la skul na dang po ma nyes pa'i gzu dang dpang gzug pa ni/ /hūṃ bh+yo ཿ rang don grub nas gzhan don rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /brgyud gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus snyan gson gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /sngags 'chang rigs la bzang po'i rgyud du skyes/ /mi rabs mang por sems can phan bde byas/ /da lta bsdu bzhis gzhan don byed pa la/ / dam nyams dgra bos ci byar ma ster ro/ /rim gsum bla mas gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /dam can srung ma gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /ri dwags bzhin du kun la bag yod byas/ /dma' ba'i sa bzung hrul po'i gos gyon yang*/ /rang yul bag yangs sdod du ma ster ro/ /yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang mdzod cig / mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /phongs pa skyong zhing 'phags pa mchod snyam yang*/ / dam nyams dgra bos bgyid du ma ster ro/ /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros gzung dang dpang mdzod cig

/bstan pa'i dam can ma lus snyan gson zhig /ye nas spros bral rang bzhin dgongs pa'i klong*/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi thig le bsgom snyam pas/ /sdang ba'i dgra bos sgom du ma ster ro/ /gsang ba'i dam can rgya mtsho dpang mdzod cing*/ /gsang bdag chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /don du lha gnyer las su chos byas shing*/ /rtag tu gzhan phan srung ma khyed mchod kyang*/ /dam nyams dgra bos sdod du ma ster ro/ /gza' mchog chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /'jig rten 'di yi nye 'brel nor dang rdzas/ /gtan yul ma lus spangs nas dam chos bsgrubs/ /srung ma brten yang mgon dang skyabs med do/ /skyes bu chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /che ba'i dpon dang mdza' bshes bkur sti bzhag /srung ma dam can rje dang grogs bzhin brten/ /gsol mchod yun du bsgrubs kyang don re chung*/ /las kyi pho nya gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ / sngags 'chang bdag la dam nyams dgra bos bsdos/ /srung ma khyed la mthu stobs med ces sgrogs/ /mchod gtor yun du brten yang don re chung*/ / gter bdag dam can ma lus snyan gson zhig /chos byed brnyas shing srung ma khyad du gsod/ /skye bo yongs kyis mi kha phyogs bcur bsgrags/ /nag po'i mthu la bu lon bzhin du bsnyags/ /sdig pa'i rnam smin 'di la yong dus med/ /dregs pa ming srid gzu dang dbang mdzod cig /bod yul lha gnyan 'khor bcas snyan gson zhig /bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag mkha' ltar yangs kyang sprin ltar 'thib tu byung*/ /spyi mthun bsod nams nyi zla 'char dbang med/ /mtsho ltar 'khyil yang dba' ltar rnyog tu byung*/ /ma nyes rang bzhin med par bsdad dbang med/ /gangs ltar dkar yang g.ya' ltar gnag tu byung*/ /bzang sems kun spyod dge ba bya dbang med/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag dang*/ /dkar phyogs lha 'dre ma lus snyan gson zhig

/nang pa rnams la mu stegs bzhin du 'tshes/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la dar dbang med/ /chos byed rnams la bgegs rigs bzhin du 'tshes/ /dam chos rin chen tshul bzhin spyad dbang med/ / bshes ltar brten yang dgra ltar 'khon du byung*/ /rigs dang mi rigs bden rdzun yul na med/ /phub ltar bzed kyang mda' ltar 'bigs su byung*/ /ngan pa'i blo la nam yang 'dzad dus med/ /sbrul ltar 'khyil yang shing ltar 'dzugs su byung*/ /ngan pa'i kun spyod 'di la bza ོ da blag med/ /bdag la sdang byed dam nyams dgra bo 'dis/ /yongs la 'tshe zhing chos byed sgom sgrub dkrugs/ /bstan pa bshig shing srung ma khyad du bsad/ /rdo rje rgyal po de ring dmangs su phab/ /de bas dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /ma lus snyan gson gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /bden rdzun shan phye dam nyams dgra bo la/ mngon spyod drag po'i bka' chad myur du phob/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad la/ /dgra bgegs thul nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /sa mā ya/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ de rbad bskul bya ba ni/ /shin tu khros nas/ hūṃ chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro la khror ston pa/ /zhi khro rab 'byams sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ /gter bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ /thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /hūṃ rab 'jigs 'bar ba klong dgu'i dur khrod nas/ /sngags bdag chen mo smug nag khros ma'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhing dbyug tsit+ta 'dzin/ /mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs myur du skrol/ /hūṃ 'jigs byed chen po gza' mchog rā hu la/ /dbu dgu phyag bzhi bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /mda' gzhu zhags pa rgyal mtshan dug mda' yis/ /dam nyams dgra yi snying la gzer chen thob/ /hūṃ skyes mchog 'bar ba dmar nag thig le rtsal/

/phyag g.yas rdo rje dam nyams dgra la gsor/ /g.yon pa snying zhags dam nyams dgra la thob/ /zhub can dmag dpung dam nyams dgra la 'phyo/ /hūṃ ma sring rgya mtsho pho nya las mkhan rnams/ /dmag dpung chos la dgra bo'i yul khams choms/ /nad kyi rkyal pa dam nyams dgra la yā/ /tshon gyi gru gu dam nyams dgra la rkyongs/ /dus kyi 'khrugs pa dam nyams dgra la yā/ /glo bur ye 'drog dam nyams dgra la thong*/ /hūṃ bod yul gter bdag mkha' 'gro bstan ma'i tshogs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can/ /so so'i dpung dang drag po'i mngon spyod kyis/ /dam nyams dgra la dus 'dir da chos shig /mi nad phyugs nad dam nyams dgra la 'phyo/ /glo bur gri rgod 'khrug pa dgra la 'phyo/ /sad dang ser chen skar mda' dgra la 'phyo/ /rings par da rgyug bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /hūṃ dam can srung ma mkha' 'gro bstan ma'i tshogs/ /dam nyams dgra bo las ngan sdig can la/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i thugs kyis da dgongs la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i rims nad khong nas slong*/ /bag bzhi sa la lhungs nas rdeb tu chug /don snying smad lnga snying khrag skyug tu chug /dam nyams 'khor bcas brang chen brdung du chug /smre sngags cong cong 'o dod 'bod du chug /'chi ba'i dug mda' smyo 'bog gsod par mdzod/ /las kyi rlung nag 'tshubs mas rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun nag chen pos mdun nas sus/ /ltag nas bdud chod mdun nas 'od 'phrog la/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul dam nyams dgra la bh+yo/ /spyang ki sngon po sha la 'dur du chug /dur khrod gcan gzan wa mo brgyal du chug /srod la khyim bya de pho mtsher du chug /sgo khyi dun po tho rangs ngu ru chug /gser gyi 'ug pa thog kar dgod du chug /ltas ngan srin bya khyim du gnod la chug /sram dang ri bong sreg pa la sogs pa/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs dam nyams dgra la thong*/ /phu nas sha pho'i rwa 'dzing dgra la thong*/

/mda' nas nya mo'i rnga 'dzing dgra la thong*/ /steng nas bya nag sder 'dzing dgra la thong*/ /'og nas sre mang bya ི khyer dgra la thong*/ /grong nas nag mo'i sdair 'dzing dgra la thong*/ /ltas ngan sna tshogs dam nyams dgra la thong*/ /glo bur ye 'drog dam nyams dgra la thong*/ /sdang byed dgra bo ma lus 'khor bcas kyi/ /gnam tshe gzugs gyi 'ju thag dkar po chod la shog /sa grib ma yi rten phur nag po phyung la shog /gnam lag ngar sa gnyis kyi 'brel thag chod la shog /mgo dang lus phrol don snying phyung la shog /dbang po lnga thon srog rtsa chod la shog /snying khrag 'jibs la dbug dang phrol la shog /steng gi khyo sod 'og gi chung ma sod/ /mchan gyi bu sod nang mi gnyen 'dun sod/ /phugs kyi sris rkus ra ba'i nor dang phrol/ / g.ya ེ yi zhing yang gtan du skyer ma gzhug /yul mkhar khyim yang rgya gram lam bzhin shig /yar gyi 'dun gsum yar la snyogs la shog /pha dang mes po rtsad nas chod la shog /mar gyi mdun gsum mar la snyogs la shog /bu dang tsha yugs rngu bas nas thon la shog /bar gyi 'dun gsum bar nas snyogs la shog /gnyen rigs srid gsum phung du chug la shog /dam nyams dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas/ /ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlog /ye shes lha dang srung ma dam can tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir las 'di grub par mdzod/ /ma ma trag rak+ṣa tri tri bh+yo ཿ raṃ bh+yo ཿ yaṃ bh+yoḥ khaṃ bh+ya ཿ e bh+yoḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo: zhes ngar bskyed la bya/ /de nas chad mdo bya ba ni/ phud dang rak+ta bran la/ hūṃ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la/ 'og min rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis/ /bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho ma lus kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ / bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/

/bcol ba'i phrin las mdzad par ma chad dam/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'gal bar/ /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /bod yul ti sgrau mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du/ / slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /slob ma mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ /snying tig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho ma lus kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas kyang*/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i phrin las mdzad par ma chad dam/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'gal bar/ /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di la bzhes la/ /thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og bar gyi bskal tshig dbus ma la/ /bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /slob dpon chen po bi ma mi tra dang*/ /slob ma rje blon byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /sngags bdag gza' dang dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas kyang*/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i phrin las mdzad par ma chad dam/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'gal bar/ /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i tha ma la/ /yar klungs sham po gangs kyi dben gnas su/ /rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza dang*/ /slob ma kun mkhyen sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ /snying tig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/

/sngags bdag gza' dang dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i phrin las mdzad par ma chad dam/ / sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'gal bar/ /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ / ces brjod nas/ bstan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor ma gang gtong de bteg nas bzhag /spos dang gsur gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgras mdzes par byas la/ hūṃ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /'dir byon rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes/ /hūṃ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong*/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang*/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mor grags pa khyed bzhi dang*/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang*/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen mor grags pa khyed bzhi dang*/ / kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*/ /btsan la drag mo rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.ya' mo sil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman btsun chen mor grags pa khyed bzhi yang*/ /rin chen lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /pho nya bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la/ /mchod dang gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du grub bar mdzod/ /hūṃ bstan ma chen mo khyed rnams la/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /rgya yul de ni gdan bzangs kyi/ /a su ra yi brag phug tu/ /rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bshams nas/ /zhing chen bsgya

ེ la ba'i gdan steng du/ /dmar chen arga'i mchod bshams nas/ /lag tu rdo rje gtad nas kyang*/ / rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /lce la arga bzhag nas kyang*/ /dam tshig bsrung par khas blangs nas/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i grogs gyis zhes/ /thar pa thob par ming btags te/ /dgos pa thams cad bsgrub po zhes/ /bran gyi tshul du khas blangs ma/ /dam tshig de las khyod ma 'da'/ /dam tshig de las khyod 'das na/ /badz+ra yak+ṣa khro bo yis/ /snying gi dkyil nas khrag drangs nas/ /'o dod 'bod par gdon mi za/ /de bas bod khams skyong ba'i tshogs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdza ོ da/ /la lā/ li lī/ dhi dhi/ dhe dhe/ rdo rje srid 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ rag mo rag mo dgra bo'i snying la bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ /zhes 'phangs so/ / spros pa la dga' na zor lam dbye ba dang*/ gtor mnan dang*/ rta bro rnams spyi gsol chen mor bstan pa bzhin bya'o/ /de nas nang du 'ong ste las kyi rjes la rol mo'i sgra dang*/ me tog gi char dbab cing*/ shis pa brjod la/ ā+oṃ bkra shis gang zhig dngos grub char du dbab/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud dang*/ /gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis gang*/ / bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog
